question: Will we hit this year's plan?
definition: Invoiced net revenue (billing date) converted to GBP at the daily rate; compared with the Finance budget converted at budget FX rates.

question: Will we hit this year's plan?
definition: FY actual to date plus remaining-month budget scaled by the last three months' actual-to-budget ratio.

question: Where is margin leaking?
definition: (Revenue - standard cost of goods invoiced) / revenue. Standard cost is the version valid on the billing date.

question: Are we keeping our promises to customers?
definition: Share of order lines shipped on or before the promised date and in the full ordered quantity. Measured on the promised week.

question: Are we keeping our promises to customers?
definition: Value of open order lines whose promised date has passed.

question: Is cash tied up in stock?
definition: Finished-goods inventory value at standard cost / average daily cost of goods sold over the last 90 days.

question: Is cash tied up in stock?
definition: Value of finished goods above 60 days of forward cover (based on the last 90 days of shipments).

question: Is quality costing us money?
definition: Scrapped quantity / (good + scrapped quantity) on confirmed production orders.

question: Is quality costing us money?
definition: Scrapped quantity valued at standard cost (GBP).

question: Is quality costing us money?
definition: Inspection lots passed first time / inspection lots.

question: Is quality costing us money?
definition: Availability x performance x quality on confirmed production orders.

question: Is the supply base putting output at risk?
definition: Purchase-order lines received on or before the due date / lines due.
